selectionPolicy: Greedy card-coverage maximization with 6 English + 6 zh-Hans cases.

cards.title: FORMING
cards.subtitle: Scattered signals begin to take shape
cards.oneLineInsight: The priority may be less about adding input and more about noticing what is taking shape.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: A structure is emerging from differences, signals, or material that has not fully settled. It points to order in formation rather than a finished answer.
cards.flowingExpression: You can recognize the emerging pattern and give it enough room to form.
cards.strainedExpression: Premature certainty can flatten distinctions that still matter.
cards.observationPrompt: What recently separate pieces are beginning to look connected?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Observe whether the stated question actually becomes important in the situations where this grammar pattern appears.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: Where does this baseline question match lived reality, and where does another question become more important?

cards.title: ADVANCE
cards.subtitle: Direction has appeared and momentum begins to organize forward
cards.oneLineInsight: When direction is clear enough, the next step moves naturally from understanding into action.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: Drive comes from initiation, execution, or bringing an organized priority into reality.
cards.flowingExpression: Action follows clear priorities and each step creates useful feedback.
cards.strainedExpression: When speed outruns orientation, advance becomes repeated course correction.
cards.observationPrompt: What smallest action would genuinely move the structure forward?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Compare the leading baseline driver with what actually receives attention and energy in the current situation.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: Does the current Reality reinforce this driver, or has another driver become more important?

cards.title: DISCERN
cards.subtitle: Recognizing the distinctions that actually matter
cards.oneLineInsight: Understanding and discernment can turn mixed signals into clearer judgment.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: The capacity for recognition, interpretation, comparison, and workable understanding.
cards.flowingExpression: Understanding changes the frame, not just the amount of information.
cards.strainedExpression: Analysis without a stopping condition can deepen indefinitely without producing a usable judgment.
cards.observationPrompt: Which distinction, once clear, would change your understanding of the whole situation?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Observe whether this capability is actually available under pressure, not only when conditions are easy.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: What real evidence shows that this capability is available right now?

cards.title: WITHDRAWAL
cards.subtitle: The system narrows new input and connection to protect stability
cards.oneLineInsight: Protection can preserve stability, but when it keeps expanding it can also close off new input and possibility.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: This card describes a system reducing input, connection, and openness to avoid further load, conflict, or uncertainty. Some contraction can be protective, but if it keeps expanding, boundaries that once preserved stability can become restrictions that block new resources, relationships, information, or change.
cards.flowingExpression: When contraction is intentional and bounded, the core can be protected while preserving the ability to reopen later.
cards.strainedExpression: When withdrawal keeps expanding, the system can become increasingly dependent on existing structures even when new support or opportunities appear.
cards.observationPrompt: Which protective moves are still necessary, and which have begun to restrict useful new input?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Observe whether the stated question actually becomes important in the situations where this grammar pattern appears.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: Where does this baseline question match lived reality, and where does another question become more important?

cards.title: CONTAINER
cards.subtitle: Complex material needs a stable enough container
cards.oneLineInsight: Support may come not from more stimulation but from a space that can hold what matters.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: Environmental conditions of containment, holding, and keeping necessary structure together.
cards.flowingExpression: The environment can hold complexity without forcing immediate completion.
cards.strainedExpression: A container without boundaries can turn support into endless holding.
cards.observationPrompt: What kind of space helps you hold things steadily instead of constantly reacting?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Observe whether the surrounding field and your actual response are moving in the same way or in different ways.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: What changes when the environment supports a different motion than the embodied response?

cards.title: OPENING
cards.subtitle: An entry is becoming possible
cards.oneLineInsight: The structure is at a point where operation can begin, but this does not mean it already has.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: This card represents the opening position of the ECR baseline activation window.
cards.flowingExpression: The entry and its conditions are recognized without treating possibility as fact.
cards.strainedExpression: Treating an opening as an outcome can let expectation outrun evidence.
cards.observationPrompt: Which conditions have only just become possible?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Observe whether the current situation shows the opening, strengthening, over-amplification, decay or closure implied by this stage.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: Which part of this activation stage is supported by current evidence, and which part remains open?

spread.customerNotice: These cards turn the existing ECR result into a more concrete visual entry point. They do not replace the full report or add new conclusions.

cards.title: DEEPENING
cards.subtitle: Moving from surface signals toward workable understanding
cards.oneLineInsight: This reading emphasizes understanding what is happening before rushing to the next move.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: The value now lies in clearer recognition and interpretation rather than more surface input.
cards.flowingExpression: Understanding changes how the issue is organized, not just how much you know.
cards.strainedExpression: Analysis without a more workable frame can turn depth into a loop.
cards.observationPrompt: Which question, if genuinely understood, would simplify the others?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Observe whether the stated question actually becomes important in the situations where this grammar pattern appears.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: Where does this baseline question match lived reality, and where does another question become more important?

cards.title: BREAKTHROUGH
cards.subtitle: The old constraint has become too narrow and a new possibility needs room
cards.oneLineInsight: Sometimes change needs a clear discontinuity rather than incremental repair.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: Momentum comes from expansion, mutation, or an old structure that can no longer contain new conditions.
cards.flowingExpression: Breakthrough creates space for a new organization while preserving what must still be held.
cards.strainedExpression: Breaking constraints without a new container can create instability rather than possibility.
cards.observationPrompt: Which constraint no longer protects the structure and now prevents something new from forming?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Compare the leading baseline driver with what actually receives attention and energy in the current situation.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: Does the current Reality reinforce this driver, or has another driver become more important?

cards.title: ORGANIZE
cards.subtitle: Turning scattered material into workable structure
cards.oneLineInsight: One available capacity is making complex material more ordered.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: The capacity to organize direction, position, resources, or differences into a workable structure.
cards.flowingExpression: Once complexity is organized, the next step becomes easier to see.
cards.strainedExpression: Over-organization can become control and reduce room for what still needs to change.
cards.observationPrompt: What most needs organizing before it needs solving?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Observe whether this capability is actually available under pressure, not only when conditions are easy.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: What real evidence shows that this capability is available right now?

cards.title: DRAIN
cards.subtitle: The runtime loses energy or support while continuing to occupy capacity
cards.oneLineInsight: When support declines, maintaining the same intensity can increase recovery cost.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: The continuing cost that can arise as energy, field support, or available capacity declines.
cards.flowingExpression: Intensity is allowed to recede while resources move toward recovery or closure.
cards.strainedExpression: Treating decline as something that must immediately be reinforced can prolong a runtime that needs to recede.
cards.observationPrompt: What no longer deserves to be maintained at the same intensity?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Observe whether the stated question actually becomes important in the situations where this grammar pattern appears.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: Where does this baseline question match lived reality, and where does another question become more important?

cards.title: CALIBRATION
cards.subtitle: The environment supports accuracy through ongoing adjustment
cards.oneLineInsight: Supportive conditions may be formed through repeated small adjustments rather than found all at once.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: A field that becomes supportive through gradual entry, feedback, and distributed influence.
cards.flowingExpression: Each feedback signal adjusts only what actually needs to change.
cards.strainedExpression: Changing everything at once removes the stable reference needed for calibration.
cards.observationPrompt: Which small adjustment is most likely to improve the whole operating experience?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Observe whether the surrounding field and your actual response are moving in the same way or in different ways.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: What changes when the environment supports a different motion than the embodied response?

cards.title: DECAY
cards.subtitle: The active configuration begins losing energy or field support
cards.oneLineInsight: Some runtimes are not failing; they are naturally losing available support.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: This card represents activation decay in the ECR baseline window.
cards.flowingExpression: Intensity is allowed to decline while resources move toward recovery, closure, or preparation.
cards.strainedExpression: Continually adding energy to preserve the old intensity can prolong a runtime that is already receding.
cards.observationPrompt: What no longer needs to be maintained at the same intensity?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Observe whether the current situation shows the opening, strengthening, over-amplification, decay or closure implied by this stage.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: Which part of this activation stage is supported by current evidence, and which part remains open?

spread.customerNotice: These cards turn the existing ECR result into a more concrete visual entry point. They do not replace the full report or add new conclusions.

cards.title: GROUNDING
cards.subtitle: Giving the structure a basis that can hold it
cards.oneLineInsight: This reading emphasizes what can actually hold the next stage, not simply moving faster.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: A structure needs boundaries, resources, a carrier, or stable conditions before it can operate sustainably.
cards.flowingExpression: When the foundation is clear, later action needs less force to stay coherent.
cards.strainedExpression: Expansion without a sufficient base can make load arrive before results.
cards.observationPrompt: What needs to become stable before other things can continue?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Observe whether the stated question actually becomes important in the situations where this grammar pattern appears.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: Where does this baseline question match lived reality, and where does another question become more important?

cards.title: CALLING
cards.subtitle: A direction keeps drawing attention and investment
cards.oneLineInsight: Some directions keep returning not because they are fully understood, but because their attraction remains real.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: This card points to a persistent directional attraction. Even before the reason is fully understood, attention, curiosity, investment, or imagination keeps returning to the same direction. Calling does not prove that direction is correct; it means the theme is persistent enough to deserve observation and validation rather than dismissal.
cards.flowingExpression: When the calling increasingly aligns with real-world evidence, attraction can become clear direction and meaningful investment.
cards.strainedExpression: When calling is romanticized, persistent attraction can be mistaken for a guaranteed answer while practical conditions are ignored.
cards.observationPrompt: What direction keeps drawing your attention across different stages, and what real-world evidence supports continuing to explore it?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Compare the leading baseline driver with what actually receives attention and energy in the current situation.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: Does the current Reality reinforce this driver, or has another driver become more important?

cards.title: HOLD
cards.subtitle: Keeping what matters viable under pressure and constraint
cards.oneLineInsight: Sometimes capacity means knowing what must be held, not what must be added.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: The capacity to maintain viability, protect necessary structure, and continue under constraint.
cards.flowingExpression: Holding remains aware of capacity and allows recovery, handoff, and closure.
cards.strainedExpression: Keeping everything on one carrier for too long can turn holding into overload.
cards.observationPrompt: What is worth continuing to hold, and what should be released or redistributed?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Observe whether this capability is actually available under pressure, not only when conditions are easy.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: What real evidence shows that this capability is available right now?

cards.title: WITHDRAWAL
cards.subtitle: The system narrows new input and connection to protect stability
cards.oneLineInsight: Protection can preserve stability, but when it keeps expanding it can also close off new input and possibility.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: This card describes a system reducing input, connection, and openness to avoid further load, conflict, or uncertainty. Some contraction can be protective, but if it keeps expanding, boundaries that once preserved stability can become restrictions that block new resources, relationships, information, or change.
cards.flowingExpression: When contraction is intentional and bounded, the core can be protected while preserving the ability to reopen later.
cards.strainedExpression: When withdrawal keeps expanding, the system can become increasingly dependent on existing structures even when new support or opportunities appear.
cards.observationPrompt: Which protective moves are still necessary, and which have begun to restrict useful new input?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Observe whether the stated question actually becomes important in the situations where this grammar pattern appears.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: Where does this baseline question match lived reality, and where does another question become more important?

cards.title: RHYTHM
cards.subtitle: A sustainable pace matters more than continuous acceleration
cards.oneLineInsight: Some structures stabilize only when movement, pause, and recovery can alternate.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: A field rhythm that supports change through movement, circulation, and adaptation around obstacles.
cards.flowingExpression: Pace adjusts to resistance and resources instead of staying at one intensity.
cards.strainedExpression: Mistaking constant activity for progress can consume capacity that could have recovered.
cards.observationPrompt: Does your reality need more speed, or a better rhythm?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Observe whether the surrounding field and your actual response are moving in the same way or in different ways.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: What changes when the environment supports a different motion than the embodied response?

cards.title: ALIGNMENT
cards.subtitle: Conditions temporarily align with lower friction
cards.oneLineInsight: This card represents a period in which several conditions can work together more easily.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: This card represents an alignment position in the ECR baseline activation window.
cards.flowingExpression: The lower-friction window is used for coordinated work while reality feedback stays active.
cards.strainedExpression: Treating alignment as permanent can make later condition changes harder to absorb.
cards.observationPrompt: What is most worth advancing while conditions are aligned?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Observe whether the current situation shows the opening, strengthening, over-amplification, decay or closure implied by this stage.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: Which part of this activation stage is supported by current evidence, and which part remains open?

cards.title: 聚焦
cards.subtitle: 从许多可能中找出真正值得放大的部分
cards.oneLineInsight: 不是每件事都需要同时处理；这次读取更强调把权重放到真正关键的位置。
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: 这张牌代表注意力与判断正在从多个可能收束到一个更值得优先处理的主题。
cards.flowingExpression: 知道什么值得先处理，能减少无效分散。
cards.strainedExpression: 如果所有讯号都被赋予同样重量，真正的主轴反而会被淹没。
cards.observationPrompt: 现在最需要被你认真放大的，究竟是哪一件事？

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: 观察这个基础问题是否真的会在对应语法模式出现时变得重要。
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: 这个基础问题在哪里符合现实经验，哪里又是另一个问题更重要？

cards.title: 完成
cards.subtitle: 未关闭的结构持续要求一个真正的结束
cards.oneLineInsight: 有些动力来自「还没有完成」本身。
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: 这张牌代表运行被未关闭的责任、流程、关系或结构持续牵引。
cards.flowingExpression: 完成释放被占用的注意与资源，让下一轮有空间开始。
cards.strainedExpression: 把结束拖成持续维护，会让过去继续占用未来的容量。
cards.observationPrompt: 什么真正完成以后，会立刻释放最多空间？

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: 把首位基线驱动与当前现实中真正获得注意力和能量的方向作比较。
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: 当前现实是在强化这个驱动，还是已经有另一个驱动变得更重要？

cards.title: 连接
cards.subtitle: 让分开的现实之间出现可工作的关系
cards.oneLineInsight: 有些问题不是缺少能力，而是需要更好的连接方式。
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: 这张牌代表在关系、共同结构与不同位置之间协调回应的能力。
cards.flowingExpression: 连接保留双方差异，同时形成真正可交换的界面。
cards.strainedExpression: 为了维持连接而失去边界，会让协调变成过度承担。
cards.observationPrompt: 哪一个连接如果重新设计，会让整个系统轻很多？

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: 观察这项能力在压力下是否仍然可用，而不只是条件轻松时可用。
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: 什么现实证据能说明这项能力目前真的可用？

cards.title: 封闭
cards.subtitle: 为了保护稳定，系统逐渐减少新的输入与连接
cards.oneLineInsight: 保护本来可以维持稳定，但当保护持续扩大，也可能逐渐关闭新的输入与可能性。
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: 这张牌代表系统为了避免进一步负荷、冲突或不确定性，开始减少输入、连接与开放程度。适度收紧有时是必要的保护，但当这个过程持续扩大，原本用于维持稳定的边界可能逐渐变成限制，使新的资源、关系、讯息或变化难以进入。
cards.flowingExpression: 当收紧是有意识且有范围的，系统可以暂时保护核心，同时保留未来重新开放的能力。
cards.strainedExpression: 当封闭持续扩大时，系统会越来越依赖已有结构，即使外部出现新的支持或机会，也可能难以进入。
cards.observationPrompt: 目前有哪些保护动作仍然有必要，哪些已经从保护变成了限制新的输入？

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: 观察这个基础问题是否真的会在对应语法模式出现时变得重要。
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: 这个基础问题在哪里符合现实经验，哪里又是另一个问题更重要？

cards.title: 边界
cards.subtitle: 清楚的界线让运行知道在哪里停止与稳定
cards.oneLineInsight: 适合你的支持不一定是完全开放，而可能是范围足够清楚。
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: 这张牌代表停止、区分、界定与稳定边界的场域条件。
cards.flowingExpression: 边界帮助资源留给真正重要的运行。
cards.strainedExpression: 边界如果只用来阻止变化，可能让环境失去更新能力。
cards.observationPrompt: 什么界线一旦说清楚，会让整个环境更容易运作？

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: 观察周围场域与你的实际回应是在以同一种方式运动，还是以不同方式运动。
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: 当环境支持的运动方式与载体回应不同，会发生什么变化？

cards.title: 启动
cards.subtitle: 结构越过入口，开始进入运行
cards.oneLineInsight: 这张牌代表运行已经从可能性向实际启动移动。
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: 这张牌表示 ECR 基线窗口越过入口阈值并开始运行。
cards.flowingExpression: 开始发生的讯号可以被观察，而不用假定它已经稳定。
cards.strainedExpression: 把刚启动的东西当成成熟结构，容易高估它的承载能力。
cards.observationPrompt: 什么已经不只是想法，而开始出现实际运行讯号？

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: 观察当前情境是否真的呈现这个阶段所描述的开启、强化、过度放大、衰退或闭合。
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: 这个激活阶段有哪些部分得到当前证据支持，哪些仍然开放？

spread.customerNotice: 这些牌把已经形成的 ECR 结果转成更具体的视觉入口；它们不会取代完整报告，也不会增加新的结论。

cards.title: 整合
cards.subtitle: 把分开的部分重新放进同一个整体
cards.oneLineInsight: 真正的问题可能不在任何单一部分，而在这些部分怎样一起运作。
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: 这张牌代表多个结构、需求或现实层面需要被放进同一个更完整的框架中理解。
cards.flowingExpression: 不同部分可以保持差异，同时仍然形成可工作的整体。
cards.strainedExpression: 为了追求一致而消除差异，会失去真正需要被协调的关系。
cards.observationPrompt: 哪两个看似分开的部分，其实需要被一起考虑？

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: 观察这个基础问题是否真的会在对应语法模式出现时变得重要。
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: 这个基础问题在哪里符合现实经验，哪里又是另一个问题更重要？

cards.title: 推进
cards.subtitle: 方向已经出现，力量开始向前组织
cards.oneLineInsight: 当方向足够清楚时，下一步会自然从理解进入行动。
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: 这张牌代表驱动力来自启动、执行或把已经形成的优先级带入现实。
cards.flowingExpression: 行动围绕清楚的优先级展开，每一步都能产生新的反馈。
cards.strainedExpression: 速度超过方向时，推进会变成不断修正路线。
cards.observationPrompt: 哪一个最小行动，能够真正让结构向前？

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: 把首位基线驱动与当前现实中真正获得注意力和能量的方向作比较。
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: 当前现实是在强化这个驱动，还是已经有另一个驱动变得更重要？

cards.title: 调整
cards.subtitle: 依据现实变化改变方法
cards.oneLineInsight: 真正稳定的能力并不是永远维持同一种做法，而是在环境变化时仍能找到新的有效方式。
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: 这张牌代表根据现实条件改变方法的能力。当原有路径不再适用，系统可以根据反馈重新调整角度、顺序、节奏或工具，而不需要彻底否定原本目标。调整的价值在于保留方向，同时改变实现方式，使结构能够继续适应变化中的现实。
cards.flowingExpression: 当调整能力良好时，现实变化不会自动造成失控，系统能够快速找到新的可行路径。
cards.strainedExpression: 当调整过度时，可能不断改变方法，导致方向没有足够时间形成稳定性；调整也可能变成逃避真正困难。
cards.observationPrompt: 当前需要改变的是目标本身，还是只需要改变实现目标的方法？

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: 观察这项能力在压力下是否仍然可用，而不只是条件轻松时可用。
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: 什么现实证据能说明这项能力目前真的可用？

cards.title: 过载
cards.subtitle: 可用容量开始小于正在承担的运行
cards.oneLineInsight: 需要留意的不是努力够不够，而是承载是否已经超过可持续范围。
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: 这张牌代表结构在持续激活、承载或执行时可能出现的容量风险。
cards.flowingExpression: 能看见容量边界，并在失稳前降低、分配或恢复负荷。
cards.strainedExpression: 用更多投入弥补容量不足，会让短期推进变成长期开销。
cards.observationPrompt: 什么已经开始需要恢复、减少或重新分配？

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: 观察这个基础问题是否真的会在对应语法模式出现时变得重要。
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: 这个基础问题在哪里符合现实经验，哪里又是另一个问题更重要？

cards.title: 校准
cards.subtitle: 环境通过持续微调与反馈支持更准确的运行
cards.oneLineInsight: 理想条件不一定一次找到，而可以通过不断的小调整逐渐形成。
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: 这张牌代表通过渐进进入、反馈与分布式影响让环境逐步适配。
cards.flowingExpression: 每次反馈只调整真正需要改变的部分。
cards.strainedExpression: 频繁改变全部条件，会让校准失去稳定参照。
cards.observationPrompt: 哪一个小调整最可能明显改善整个运行感受？

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: 观察周围场域与你的实际回应是在以同一种方式运动，还是以不同方式运动。
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: 当环境支持的运动方式与载体回应不同，会发生什么变化？

cards.title: 过度放大
cards.subtitle: 激活强度开始超过较平衡范围
cards.oneLineInsight: 这张牌不是坏预兆，而是在提醒：更多并不一定继续带来更好。
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: 这张牌表示 ECR 基线窗口处于激活过度放大阶段，结构成本可能提高。
cards.flowingExpression: 能够降低强度、恢复余量，并保留真正必要的活动。
cards.strainedExpression: 继续用同样强度推进，可能让有效模式逐渐僵化或过载。
cards.observationPrompt: 什么正在因为「太多」而开始失去原本的效果？

cards.subtitle: The system narrows new input and connection to protect stability
cards.oneLineInsight: Protection can preserve stability, but when it keeps expanding it can also close off new input and possibility.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: This card describes a system reducing input, connection, and openness to avoid further load, conflict, or uncertainty. Some contraction can be protective, but if it keeps expanding, boundaries that once preserved stability can become restrictions that block new resources, relationships, information, or change.
cards.flowingExpression: When contraction is intentional and bounded, the core can be protected while preserving the ability to reopen later.
cards.strainedExpression: When withdrawal keeps expanding, the system can become increasingly dependent on existing structures even when new support or opportunities appear.
cards.observationPrompt: Which protective moves are still necessary, and which have begun to restrict useful new input?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Observe whether the stated question actually becomes important in the situations where this grammar pattern appears.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: Where does this baseline question match lived reality, and where does another question become more important?

cards.title: RHYTHM
cards.subtitle: A sustainable pace matters more than continuous acceleration
cards.oneLineInsight: Some structures stabilize only when movement, pause, and recovery can alternate.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: A field rhythm that supports change through movement, circulation, and adaptation around obstacles.
cards.flowingExpression: Pace adjusts to resistance and resources instead of staying at one intensity.
cards.strainedExpression: Mistaking constant activity for progress can consume capacity that could have recovered.
cards.observationPrompt: Does your reality need more speed, or a better rhythm?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Observe whether the surrounding field and your actual response are moving in the same way or in different ways.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: What changes when the environment supports a different motion than the embodied response?

cards.title: OPENING
cards.subtitle: An entry is becoming possible
cards.oneLineInsight: The structure is at a point where operation can begin, but this does not mean it already has.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: This card represents the opening position of the ECR baseline activation window.
cards.flowingExpression: The entry and its conditions are recognized without treating possibility as fact.
cards.strainedExpression: Treating an opening as an outcome can let expectation outrun evidence.
cards.observationPrompt: Which conditions have only just become possible?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Observe whether the current situation shows the opening, strengthening, over-amplification, decay or closure implied by this stage.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: Which part of this activation stage is supported by current evidence, and which part remains open?

cards.title: 聚焦
cards.subtitle: 从许多可能中找出真正值得放大的部分
cards.oneLineInsight: 不是每件事都需要同时处理；这次读取更强调把权重放到真正关键的位置。
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: 这张牌代表注意力与判断正在从多个可能收束到一个更值得优先处理的主题。
cards.flowingExpression: 知道什么值得先处理，能减少无效分散。
cards.strainedExpression: 如果所有讯号都被赋予同样重量，真正的主轴反而会被淹没。
cards.observationPrompt: 现在最需要被你认真放大的，究竟是哪一件事？

cards.title: 召唤
cards.subtitle: 某个方向持续吸引注意与投入
cards.oneLineInsight: 有些方向之所以不断回来，并不是因为已经想清楚，而是它持续保持真实吸引力。
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: 这张牌表示当前动力来自一种持续存在的方向性吸引。即使尚未能完全解释为什么，注意、好奇、投入或想象仍不断回到同一个方向。召唤并不证明这个方向一定正确，它只是说明：这个主题具有足够持续性，值得被认真观察和验证，而不是立即忽略。
cards.flowingExpression: 当召唤与现实证据逐渐对齐时，吸引力可以转化成清楚方向与有意义的投入。
cards.strainedExpression: 当召唤被浪漫化时，系统可能因为“很有感觉”而忽略实际条件，把持续吸引误认为必然答案。
cards.observationPrompt: 什么方向总是在不同阶段重新吸引你的注意？现实中有没有证据支持它值得继续探索？

cards.title: 洞察
cards.subtitle: 从讯号中辨认真正重要的差异
cards.oneLineInsight: 你可以通过理解与辨识，把混杂的讯号变成更清楚的判断。
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: 这张牌代表识别、解释、比较与形成可用理解的能力。
cards.flowingExpression: 理解不仅增加资讯，也改变你看问题的框架。
cards.strainedExpression: 分析如果没有停止条件，可能持续深化却不产生可用判断。
cards.observationPrompt: 什么差异一旦看清楚，会改变你对整件事的理解？

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: 观察这项能力在压力下是否仍然可用，而不只是条件轻松时可用。
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: 什么现实证据能说明这项能力目前真的可用？

cards.title: 封闭
cards.subtitle: 为了保护稳定，系统逐渐减少新的输入与连接
cards.oneLineInsight: 保护本来可以维持稳定，但当保护持续扩大，也可能逐渐关闭新的输入与可能性。
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: 这张牌代表系统为了避免进一步负荷、冲突或不确定性，开始减少输入、连接与开放程度。适度收紧有时是必要的保护，但当这个过程持续扩大，原本用于维持稳定的边界可能逐渐变成限制，使新的资源、关系、讯息或变化难以进入。
cards.flowingExpression: 当收紧是有意识且有范围的，系统可以暂时保护核心，同时保留未来重新开放的能力。
cards.strainedExpression: 当封闭持续扩大时，系统会越来越依赖已有结构，即使外部出现新的支持或机会，也可能难以进入。
cards.observationPrompt: 目前有哪些保护动作仍然有必要，哪些已经从保护变成了限制新的输入？

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: 观察这个基础问题是否真的会在对应语法模式出现时变得重要。

cards.title: 容器

cards.oneLineInsight: 支持你的条件可能不是更多刺激，而是一个能把重要东西稳稳放住的空间。
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: 这张牌代表稳定容器、承载与保持必要结构的环境条件。
cards.flowingExpression: 环境能够承载复杂性，不要求每个部分立刻完成。
cards.strainedExpression: 容器如果没有边界，会从支持空间变成无限承接。
cards.observationPrompt: 什么样的空间会让你更容易把事情放稳，而不是一直应付？

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: 观察周围场域与你的实际回应是在以同一种方式运动，还是以不同方式运动。
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: 当环境支持的运动方式与载体回应不同，会发生什么变化？

cards.title: 启动
cards.subtitle: 结构越过入口，开始进入运行
cards.oneLineInsight: 这张牌代表运行已经从可能性向实际启动移动。
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: 这张牌表示 ECR 基线窗口越过入口阈值并开始运行。
cards.flowingExpression: 开始发生的讯号可以被观察，而不用假定它已经稳定。
cards.strainedExpression: 把刚启动的东西当成成熟结构，容易高估它的承载能力。
cards.observationPrompt: 什么已经不只是想法，而开始出现实际运行讯号？

cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: 这张牌代表多个结构、需求或现实层面需要被放进同一个更完整的框架中理解。
cards.flowingExpression: 不同部分可以保持差异，同时仍然形成可工作的整体。
